items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I made a lot of records with Krupa, with little groups^ Jack Teagarden and Charlie Teagarden

ctx.x: And I had played on records organized by Red Norvo; I made a lot of records with Krupa, with little groups^ Jack Teagarden and Charlie Teagarden and you probably did, too, all the mixed bands in those days did.
